drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with CC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 86-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.62, creatinine 0.85-0.87, hemoglobin 13-13.2, platelets 231-238, sodium 124-127, wbc 5.2-5.9; vitals dbp 73-77, heart_rate 76-80, map 92-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 129-132, spo2 97-99, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Fluid restriction 1.2 L/day; Sodium chloride 1 g PO TID
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Hyponatremia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.86-0.88, hemoglobin 12.9-13.2, platelets 229-240, sodium 127-129, wbc 5.3-5.8; vitals dbp 72-76, heart_rate 77-80, map 91-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 128-134, spo2 97-98, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Hyponatremia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 86-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Hyponatremia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
